name: robne-deck
description: Marp presentations: ROS-OCP Native Engine (engineering and customer decks)

scripts.build:eng: marp --no-stdin slides-eng.md --theme-set themes/ -o dist/eng.html --allow-local-files && node scripts/zoomable-images.mjs dist/eng.html && cp -r assets dist/
scripts.build:customer: marp --no-stdin slides-customer.md --theme-set themes/ -o dist/customer.html --allow-local-files && node scripts/zoomable-images.mjs dist/customer.html && cp -r assets dist/
scripts.preview:site: npm run build:customer && npm run build:eng && npm run build:handouts && npm run assemble:site
scripts.build:handouts: npm run build:pdf:customer && npm run build:pdf:eng && npm run build:pptx:customer && npm run build:pptx:eng
